title: Rotate right by k
prompt:
Rotate the array **right by k** positions (each element moves forward, wrapping: last becomes first). Mutate the array in place. Implement `rotate(int[] arr, int k)` where 0 ≤ k (k may exceed length — then it wraps; k % length == 0 changes nothing).

Example: `{1,2,3,4,5}`, k=2 → `{4,5,1,2,3}`.

tests.name: rotated array
tests.hint: k %= length first; tmp[(i + k) % length] = arr[i] into a temp array, then copy back.
